source_title: CSX Indianapolis, IN - Mid-America Freight Coalition; Transportation - Avon, IN
contact_statement: CSX Indianapolis/Avon intermodal terminal is linked to I-465 via Rockville Road/SR 36 and Ronald Reagan Parkway, with regional access to I-70/I-65/I-69/I-74.
Port NOLA truck directions for Alabo Street Wharf route westbound access via I-510 South to St. Claude Avenue before Caffin Avenue/Chartres Street/Alabo Street terminal access.
Port NOLA truck directions for riverfront terminals use Business 90 W to Tchoupitoulas Street and for Jourdan Road Terminal use U.S. 90 W/Chef Menteur Highway to Jourdan Road terminal access.
